edits.limits: a list to confirm: no hit is not proof (an edit by interpreter code such as a python3 heredoc, a shell apply_patch or git apply, a kill by numeric pid or by port, and a relative path after cd other than the three workspace files, matched by name, are not seen) and a hit can be quoted text read as a command (a quoted > word reads as a redirect)

refusals.limits: read from ShipLoop's run trace: every command that named the run and exited non-zero, a failed check (`shiploop check`, or `complete --check-only` before it) flagged, a routed verb's (lint, red-check) with no text; a command that named no run (a workspace verb on --workspace-root) or did not parse is read from the stream (source events.jsonl), so one a pipe hid is missing, as is a command on a wrong --run-dir; a repeat is the same whole first line in the same stage as the refusal just before it, neutral about cause
